A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
therapists who are more emotionally congruent with their clients, and therapists who express more intense emotions than their clients, tend to have more successful outcomes.

The main takeaway from our work is that

therapists should be aware of the emotional climate in their sessions, and be sensitive to the fact that the emotional climate is a dynamic process that can be influenced by the therapists’ emotional reactions to their clients’ emotions.

therapists should strive to match their clients’ emotional intensity, and that therapists who are emotionally incongruent with their clients should be aware of the potential consequences of their emotional incongruence on treatment progress.
